manufacturer.sentenceEn: Identifying why the fast-fashion business model creates waste and determining whether regulators can establish incentives for consumers and manufacturers are steps to reduce waste.
manufacturer.translationZh: 找出快时尚商业模式产生浪费的原因，并确定监管机构是否可以为消费者和制造商制定激励措施，这些都是减少浪费的步骤。
manufacturer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

manufacturer.sentenceEn: Bottled water manufacturers base their arguments against bans of plastic bottles on health concerns rather than on profits.
manufacturer.translationZh: 瓶装水制造商反对塑料瓶禁令的理由是出于健康考虑，而非利润。

manufacturer.sentenceEn: They tell patients to comply with the directions of drug manufacturers .

muscle.sentenceEn: What does he do to strengthen his muscles and all that?

muscle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

muscle.sentenceEn: Willpower is just like a muscle ; to keep it strong you need to constantly exercise it.

mission.sentenceEn: This mission is founded on the proposition that all people, regardless of race, gender, income, or geography, have a moral right to a healthy, sustainable environment.

mission.sentenceEn: Today, the Earth Day Network, which rallies more than 20,000 partners and organizations in 190 countries, supports the Earth Day mission year-round.

mission.translationZh: 地球日网络通过教育、公共政策以及行动主义运动来履行这一使命。

mission.sentenceEn: Without persuasion skills, employees may not be as committed to or convinced of the importance of an organization's vision and long-term mission .

motivate.sentenceEn: Effective use of persuasion skills will not only help get your coworkers excited about your ideas, it'll also help you motivate them to achieve a common goal.

motivate.sentenceEn: Let that small longing you feel motivate you to make a difference.
motivate.translationZh: 让你心中感受到的那份小小的渴望激励你去改变世界。

motivate.sentenceEn: Executive function is a term for the skills one needs to plan, organize, motivate , concentrate and memorize.
motivate.translationZh: 执行功能是一个术语，指的是人们进行规划、组织、激励、集中注意力和记忆所需的各项技能。
motivate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

motivate.sentenceEn: Participation of ninth graders in Design Ventura can motivate them to choose design technology as their subject.
motivate.translationZh: 九年级学生参与“设计先锋”项目能够激励他们选择设计技术作为自己的学科。

means.sentenceEn: Telling stories is one of the most powerful means leaders have to influence, teach and inspire.

mobile.translationZh: 美国国家安全委员会表示，难怪开车时使用手机每年造成的车祸比酒后驾车还多。

mobile.translationZh: 手机已经改变了我们的生活方式，以及我们阅读、工作、交流和购物的方式。

Also, speak to the person you're booking the villa with on a landline phone, as fraudsters tend to only use mobiles ."

mobile.sentenceEn: What does the report say we have not yet understood about mobile phones?
mobile.translationZh: 报告称我们对于手机还有什么尚未了解的地方？

mobile.sentenceEn: Both groups spend a lot of time on mobile devices.
mobile.translationZh: 两组儿童都花大量时间在移动设备上。

movement.sentenceEn: Analysts don't expect the meat-free movement to slow anytime soon; a 2021 report predicts the market will skyrocket to $74 billion by 2030—a 957 percent surge.
movement.translationZh: 分析师预计无肉运动短期内不会放缓；2021年的一份报告预测，到2030年该市场将飙升至740亿美元，增幅达957%。

movement.sentenceEn: Adults dream during REM (rapid eye movement ) sleep and infants have loads of REM.

movement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

movement.sentenceEn: Earth Day is an annual celebration that honors the achievements of the environmental movement and raises awareness of the need to protect Earth's natural resources for future generations.
movement.translationZh: 世界地球日是一项年度纪念活动，旨在赞颂环保运动所取得的成就，并提高人们保护地球自然资源以造福子孙后代的意识。
movement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

movement.sentenceEn: Environmental activism during the 1960s inspired Wisconsin Senator Gaylord Nelson to create a national celebration uniting the environmental movement .
movement.translationZh: 20世纪60年代的环境保护运动激发了威斯康星州参议员盖洛德·尼尔森的灵感，他发起了一项全国性的庆祝活动，旨在将环境保护运动联合起来。

movement.translationZh: 受影响区域的身体活动会变得困难。

microwave.sentenceEn: The microwave and fast-food chains were the biggest catalysts(催化剂), but the big food companies—which want to sell anything except the raw ingredients that go into cooking—made the home cook an endangered species.
microwave.translationZh: 微波炉和快餐连锁店是最大的催化剂，但大型食品公司——它们想销售除烹饪原料以外的任何东西——使家庭烹饪者变成了濒危物种。

microwave.sentenceEn: "It is electricity consumption by microwaves that has the biggest impact on the environment," say the authors.
microwave.translationZh: 研究作者表示：“微波炉的耗电量对环境影响最大。”
microwave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

microwave.sentenceEn: However, David Reay, professor of carbon management, argues that, although microwaves use a great deal of energy, their emissions are minor compared to those from cars.
microwave.translationZh: 然而，碳管理教授大卫·雷伊认为，尽管微波炉能耗较高，但与汽车相比，其排放量微不足道。
microwave.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

microwave.sentenceEn: A study by the University of Manchester calculated the emissions of CO2—the main greenhouse gas responsible for climate change—at every stage of microwaves , from manufacture to waste disposal.
microwave.translationZh: 曼彻斯特大学的一项研究计算了微波炉从生产到废弃处理每个阶段的二氧化碳排放量——二氧化碳是导致气候变化的主要温室气体。

meaningful.sentenceEn: Successful persuasion skills are based on your ability to have positive interactions and maintain meaningful relationships with people.

meaningful.translationZh: 近期多项研究发现，即便是短时间的低强度运动，也能对健康产生显著影响。

meaningful.translationZh: 这是由于部长们缺乏行动，多年来未能采取任何有意义的举措。

meaningful.sentenceEn: Learning can benefit you by itself, but only practice can turn what you learn into meaningful contributions.
meaningful.translationZh: 学习本身就能让你受益，但只有实践才能将所学转化为有意义的贡献。

meaningful.sentenceEn: We do meaningful work that contributes to society.
meaningful.translationZh: 我们从事着对社会有贡献的有意义的工作。

massive.sentenceEn: For anyone who wants to help make this year's Games a massive success, there are still opportunities to volunteer for Fayetteville's Special Olympics.

massive.sentenceEn: Then there are the questions over the value of massive open online courses (MOOCs) themselves—both for refugees and for average learners.
massive.translationZh: 此外，大规模开放在线课程（MOOCs）本身的价值也受到质疑——无论是对难民还是普通学习者而言。

mindset.translationZh: 也就是说，我们教给他们一种关于社交生活的成长型思维模式。

mindset.sentenceEn: In one recent study, we examined 360 adolescents' beliefs about the nature of "smartness"—that is, their fixed mindsets about intelligence.

mindset.sentenceEn: Past research has called these beliefs " mindsets (思维模式)," with a "fixed mindset " referring to the belief that people cannot change and a "growth mindset " referring to the belief that people can change.

mindset.sentenceEn: If students believed that intelligence could improve—that is to say, when they held more of a growth mindset of intelligence—they showed lower levels of stress hormones when their grades were declining.

mindset.sentenceEn: Researchers would like to explore further how parents and schools can help ninth graders by changing their mindset .

meanwhile.sentenceEn: Active practice, meanwhile , is one of the greatest forms of learning because the mistakes you make while practicing reveal important insights.

minor.sentenceEn: If we're not careful about all these minor problems right now, the effect on the future generation is going to be much bigger.

motivation.sentenceEn: The researchers argued that previous interventions have probably been unsuccessful because of a major flaw: they focused on a future, healthier you and assumed that this would be enough motivation for teenagers.
motivation.translationZh: 研究人员认为，之前的干预措施之所以未能奏效，是因为存在一个重大缺陷：这些措施侧重于塑造一个更健康的未来自我，并假设这对青少年来说已经具备了足够的动力。
motivation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

motivation.sentenceEn: Even with an incredible amount of talent, without the discipline and motivation to create positive habits, it can be difficult to achieve success.
motivation.translationZh: 即使拥有惊人的天赋，若缺乏培养积极习惯的自律和动力，也难以取得成功。
motivation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

motivation.sentenceEn: The best way to create and stick to a habit is to have strong motivation .
motivation.translationZh: 养成并坚持一个习惯的最佳方法是拥有强大的动力。
motivation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

motivation.sentenceEn: Ford takes the reader through the evolution of fashion while examining the underlying motivations of status, sex, power, and personality, which, he assumes, influenced all innovations in fashion in the past and which continue to influence us today.
motivation.translationZh: 福特带领读者回顾了时尚的演变历程，同时探讨了地位、性别、权力和个性这些深层动机——他认为这些因素不仅影响了过去所有的时尚创新，至今仍在影响着我们。
motivation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

motivation.sentenceEn: Informing students about the brain as a learning machine is a good strategy to enhance their motivation for learning.
motivation.translationZh: 向学生介绍大脑是一台学习机器，是增强他们学习动力的好策略。

motivation.sentenceEn: They were based on the assumption that motivation was the only key.
motivation.translationZh: 这些都是基于“动力是唯一关键”这一假设而得出的。

mass.sentenceEn: But even when these accounts touch on real concerns, they do not really reflect the great mass of everyday teenage social behaviour: the online chat, the texting, the surfing, and the emergence of a new teenage sphere that is conducted digitally.
mass.translationZh: 但即便这些报道触及了真实的担忧，它们也未能真正反映青少年日常社交行为的全貌：在线聊天、发送短信、网络浏览，以及一个全新的数字化青少年社交领域的出现。

mass.sentenceEn: Researchers have shown that body mass index is related to wages and income.
mass.translationZh: 研究人员已证实，体重指数与薪资收入相关。

mass.sentenceEn: In one US study that analysed the health data of 50,000 people over seven years, researchers found that those who made breakfast the largest meal of the day were more likely to have a lower body mass index (BMI) than those who ate a large lunch or dinner.
mass.translationZh: 在美国一项对5万人长达七年的健康数据分析研究中，研究人员发现，将早餐作为一天中最丰盛一餐的人，其身体质量指数(BMI)往往低于那些午餐或晚餐吃得丰盛的人。

mass.sentenceEn: Dorchester County officials apologized for the accidental mass killing of bees.
mass.translationZh: 多切斯特县官员对此次意外大规模杀死蜜蜂事件表示道歉。

mood.sentenceEn: Science says that the clothes we wear affect our behavior, our mood and even the way we interact with others because of the symbolic meaning that we assign to different types of clothing.
mood.translationZh: 科学表明，我们穿的衣服会影响我们的行为、情绪，甚至与他人互动的方式，这是因为我们赋予不同类型的服装以象征意义。
mood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

mood.sentenceEn: Beginning first with the influence of exercise intensity on the mood benefits of aerobic exercise, the researchers, led by John Chan at Shenzhen University, found contradictory results from 19 relevant studies.
mood.translationZh: 首先从运动强度对有氧运动情绪效益的影响开始，由深圳大学陈约翰（John Chan）领导的研究人员从19项相关研究中发现了相互矛盾的结果。
mood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

mood.sentenceEn: Yet whereas most countries have detailed, evidence-backed guidelines on the type and intensity of exercise required for various physical health benefits, such guidelines do not yet exist for exercise and mood .
mood.translationZh: 然而，尽管大多数国家都有详细的、有证据支持的指南，规定了获得各种身体健康益处所需的运动类型和强度，但针对运动与情绪的此类指南尚未问世。
mood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

mood.sentenceEn: In relation to the intensity of anaerobic exercise, however, the results were far clearer—the optimum(最佳选择) for improving mood is moderate intensity, perhaps because low intensity is too dull while high intensity is too unpleasant.
mood.translationZh: 然而，就无氧运动强度而言，研究结果要明确得多——改善情绪的最佳选择是中等强度，这可能是因为低强度过于枯燥，而高强度又令人不适。
mood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

mood.sentenceEn: We believe that we will be different tomorrow; but in doing so, we prioritize our current mood over the consequences of our inaction for the future self.
mood.translationZh: 我们相信明天的自己会有所不同；但在这样想的同时，我们却把当下的情绪置于优先地位，而忽视了不作为对未来自我的后果。

mood.sentenceEn: People are ungrateful when in a bad mood .
mood.translationZh: 人们在心情不好时会显得不那么感恩。

marketing.sentenceEn: "One of the really useful things about this competition," says Hourican, "is that there's a commercial element because the product is going on sale for real and the boys had to learn about budgeting and marketing , as well as designing their game."

marketing.sentenceEn: As is so often the case, clever marketing can beat reason; awareness is rarely enough.
marketing.translationZh: 情况往往如此：巧妙的营销能够战胜理性，仅仅提高认知度远远不够。

marketing.sentenceEn: Before plastic and the marketing that made people think they needed bottled water in the first place, fountains were an urban fixture.
marketing.translationZh: 在塑料出现以及让人们觉得自己首先需要瓶装水的营销活动兴起之前，喷泉曾是城市里的常见设施。

marketing.sentenceEn: In fact, there's a good chance the marketing department purposely priced the medium soda as a decoy(诱饵), making you more likely to buy the large soda rather than the small.

mobility.sentenceEn: This is a city of immigrants—38 percent of the city's population today is foreign-born—and immigrants and their children have historically experienced significant upward mobility in America.
mobility.translationZh: 这是一座移民城市——如今该市38%的人口为外国出生——而历史上，移民及其子女在美国经历了显著的向上流动。

mobility.sentenceEn: But San Jose also performs poorly on some of the measures correlated with good mobility .

mobility.sentenceEn: The city has long had a large foreign-born population (26.5 percent in 1990), leading to broader diversity, which, the Harvard and Berkeley economists say, is a good predictor of mobility .

mobility.sentenceEn: As far as social mobility is concerned, San Jose beat many other progressive cities in America.

mechanism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

mechanism.sentenceEn: Tooth pain is a defense mechanism that ensures when a tooth is being damaged we'll notice and do something about it.
mechanism.translationZh: 牙齿疼痛是一种防御机制，它能确保当牙齿受到损伤时，我们会注意到并采取相应措施。
mechanism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

mechanism.sentenceEn: Researchers from the University of Surrey and University of Aberdeen are halfway through research looking into the mechanisms behind how the time we eat influences body weight.

mechanism.sentenceEn: "These digital products aren't just mechanisms for students to submit homework, they offer all kinds of features," David Anderson, the executive director of higher education with the Association of American Publishers, told BuzzFeed News.

mechanism.sentenceEn: Normal forgetting may even be a safety mechanism to ensure our brain doesn't become too full.

melanoma.sentenceEn: Melanomas are the most aggressive skin cancers.
melanoma.translationZh: 黑色素瘤是最具侵袭性的皮肤癌。

melanoma.translationZh: 如果周期性地强烈暴露在阳光下，患黑瘤的可能性会更高。
melanoma.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

melanoma.sentenceEn: Research in this week's Nature shows that while factor 50 reduces the number of melanomas (黑瘤) and delays their occurrence, it can't prevent them.
melanoma.translationZh: 本周《自然》杂志上的研究表明，尽管SPF50防晒霜能减少黑瘤的数量并延缓其发生，但无法完全阻止黑瘤的出现。
melanoma.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

melanoma.sentenceEn: There is continuing debate as to how effective sunscreen is in reducing melanomas —the evidence is weaker than it is for preventing other types of skin cancer.
melanoma.translationZh: 关于防晒霜在减少黑瘤方面的效果如何，目前仍存在争议——其证据不如在预防其他类型皮肤癌方面的证据有力。
melanoma.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

melanoma.sentenceEn: What does the author suggest to reduce melanoma rates?
melanoma.translationZh: 作者建议如何降低黑瘤发病率？

melanoma.sentenceEn: Daily application of sunscreen helps reduce the incidence of melanomas .
melanoma.translationZh: 每天涂抹防晒霜有助于降低黑瘤的发病率。

mere.sentenceEn: A recent study concluded that regardless of whether people are actually handling several tasks or not, the mere fact that they perceive this activity as multitasking has a positive effect on their performance.
mere.translationZh: 最近的一项研究得出结论：无论人们是否真的在处理多项任务，只要他们将这种活动视为多任务处理，就会对其表现产生积极影响。
mere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

mere.sentenceEn: A mere acquaintance entering our intimate space makes us uncomfortable.

mere.sentenceEn: You might think of your teeth as tools, like built-in knives and forks, but if they are mere tools, why do they feel pain and wouldn't it be better if they could just chew under any condition?
mere.translationZh: 你可能会把牙齿当成工具，就像内置的刀叉一样，但如果它们仅仅是工具，为什么会感到疼痛呢？如果牙齿能在任何情况下都可以咀嚼，岂不是更好？

millennial.sentenceEn: A new batch of young women—members of the so-called Millennial (千禧的) generation—has been entering the workforce for the past decade.

millennial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句
